plan.source: First successful local Zebra tip observation; block identity fetched and verified separately.
plan.prep: Earliest writer observation of a matching header in the shared archive; includes polling, admission, transport and decoding.
plan.commit: Writer observes successful applyBatch return after PostgreSQL commit acknowledgement.
plan.graphql: First completed coherent GraphQL response with the expected block hash and transaction count.
plan.timing: Same-host process.hrtime.bigint monotonic timestamps. Observation/polling bounds, not exact publication times. Negative stage observations are preserved.
plan.comparison: Published Chef 0.2.0 and two-second polling are fixed. A separate bounded shadow follower ingests actual node blocks from tip minus32 with full integrity/one confirmation. Original and queued-metadata Prep share that tail archive, schema, database server and cgroup. Binary assignments cross after six future paired blocks; source URLs and project identities stay fixed. Each source receives two simultaneous 16-block background queries every two seconds.
plan.acceptance: All source entities/restarts pass and all12 pairs complete. Queued candidate has no timed GraphQL probe failures, its source-to-GraphQL p95 is no higher, and its background request failures do not exceed the original source. Original-source failures are retained, not used to reject a healthy candidate.
plan.failures: Timed readiness gates and writer/control throttling are retained. Finite verification commands alone may retry 429/503 up to five attempts outside live timing; every retry is recorded.
plan.cache: Native archive-open and indexer bootstrap are excluded from paired timing and recorded separately; shared source/database/OS data are warm, new namespaces, no cache clearing.
plan.restart: One graceful and one SIGKILL stop per actor, after acknowledged committed data; no crash injected inside a SQL transaction.
